reading.title: Can cities be sustainable?
reading.text: More than half of the world's population now lives in cities, and many experts doubt that this growth is sustainable. Old buildings are expensive to maintain and retain heat poorly, so tenants in rented flats often pay huge energy bills. Some cities have obtained funding to insulate homes, but landlords cannot always be persuaded to take part. Meanwhile, planners try to contain urban sprawl by building upwards rather than outwards. The aim is to sustain economic growth while cutting energy use, a balance that no major city has fully achieved yet.
